notes.title: Walking In The Abyss: Definitive Edition - Major Update Notes
notes.content:
I am thrilled to present the definitive edition of Walking In The Abyss! This update brings a range of improvements and new features to enhance your terrifying experience:

[b]New Engine[/b]: The game has been migrated from RPG Maker VX Ace to RPG Maker MZ, ensuring better performance and new functionalities.
[b]Remastered Textures[/b]: Now with high-resolution graphics for a sharper visual experience.
[b]Screen Options[/b]: Choose between fullscreen or windowed mode directly from the menu.
[b]Repositioned Items[/b]: Some items have been moved on the map to improve gameplay flow.
[b]New Main Menu[/b]: Redesigned background art for a more immersive look.
[b]Spanish Language[/b]: Play in Spanish! The language can be changed at any time during gameplay.
[b]Customizable Window Mode[/b]: Resize the game window to your preference.
[b]Audio Controls[/b]: Adjust individual volumes for music, effects, and other sounds in the options menu.
[b]Updated Faces[/b]: Some characters now have updated faces in dialogue boxes and during gameplay.
[b]Mouse Compatibility[/b]: You can now navigate the menu using the mouse.

Thank you for your continued support! I can't wait for you to experience the improvements in this definitive edition.

The Abyss awaits you!

notes.title: Multiple Endings
notes.content:
[h3]It is with great excitement that I announce the new update for your journey into the macabre world of "Walking in the Abyss." Check out the key changes below:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]New Accessible Areas:[/b]
Explore uncharted territories while uncovering deeper secrets of the abyss.

[*] [b]New Endings for Jack's Story Conclusion:[/b]
Jack's narrative takes new twists with multiple endings. Your choices will shape his destiny, providing distinct experiences for players.

[*] [b]New Steam Achievements:[/b]
Unlock new achievements as you face additional challenges and explore the new available areas.

[*] [b]Enhanced Controls:[/b]
Now, in addition to the arrow keys, players can use the WASD keys to control the character, providing greater flexibility and comfort.

[*] [b]Face Graphics Update:[/b]
Some graphic enhancements have been made to the character face images.
[/list]

Thank you for your dedication in exploring the depths of the abyss. I hope these additions further enrich your journey. Good luck, the darkness awaits!

notes.title: WITA v2.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h3]It is with great excitement that I announce the new update for your journey into the macabre world of "Walking in the Abyss." Check out the key changes below:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] [b]New Accessible Areas:[/b]
Explore uncharted territories as you unravel deeper secrets of the abyss.

[*] [b]New Endings for Jack's Story Conclusion:[/b]
Jack's narrative unfolds with new twists and multiple endings. Your choices will shape his destiny, providing distinct experiences for players.

[*] [b]New Steam Achievements:[/b]
Unlock new achievements as you face additional challenges and explore the newly available areas.

[*] [b]Removal of the Gold Window in the Start Menu:[/b]
Simplified start menu interface without the gold window, offering a cleaner and narrative-focused experience.

[*] [b]Enhanced Controls:[/b]
Players can now use both arrow keys and WASD for character control, providing greater flexibility and comfort.

[*] [b]Tutorial on Acquiring the First Item:[/b]
Clear information on how to view item details in the menu upon acquiring the first item in the game.

[*] [b]Facial Graphics Update:[/b]
Some graphical improvements have been made to facial expressions for characters.
[/olist]

Thank you for your dedication to exploring the depths of the abyss. I hope these additions further enrich your journey. Good luck, the darkness awaits!
